description: This Python module provides utility functions for handling Fama-French data, including data retrieval, parsing CSV and DAT files, processing international portfolios, and downloading datasets from specified URLs. It is part of a financial data analysis project, particularly dealing with US and international portfolios and factors.

methods.name: get_factor_choices( region: Optional[str] = None, factor: Optional[str] = None, is_portfolio: bool = False, portfolio: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of factor or portfolio choices based on specified region, factor, and portfolio parameters for populating UI dropdowns.

methods.name: str download_file(dataset)
methods.description: Downloads specified dataset files from the Ken French data library, caching the results for efficiency.

methods.name: download_international_portfolios(url)
methods.description: Fetches international index or country portfolio data zip files from the provided URL.

methods.name: apply_date(x)
methods.description: Converts various date string formats into a standard YYYY-MM-DD format.

methods.name: read_csv_file(data: str)
methods.description: Parses raw CSV data into structured tables and extracts metadata.

methods.name: tuple process_csv_tables(tables, general_description="")
methods.description: Converts parsed CSV tables into pandas DataFrames with additional metadata.

methods.name: list read_dat_file(data: str)
methods.description: Parses raw DAT file data into structured tables for international portfolios.

methods.name: str get_international_portfolio_data( index: Optional[str] = None, country: Optional[str] = None, dividends: bool = True, )
methods.description: Downloads and extracts international index or country portfolio data, returning raw CSV content.

methods.name: tuple process_international_portfolio_data(tables: list, dividends: bool = True)
methods.description: Transforms parsed international portfolio tables into pandas DataFrames with multi-index columns.

methods.name: tuple get_international_portfolio( index: Optional[str] = None, country: Optional[str] = None, dividends: bool = True, frequency: Optional[str] = None, measure: Optional[str] = None, all_data_items_required: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves and processes international portfolio data for a given index or country, supporting multiple measures and frequencies.

methods.name: tuple get_portfolio_data( dataset: str, frequency: Optional[str] = None, measure: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Fetches US portfolio data for a specified dataset, filtering by frequency and measure.

methods.name: tuple get_breakpoint_data( breakpoint_type: str, )
methods.description: Retrieves US breakpoint data for a specified breakpoint type, returning organized pandas DataFrames.
